run_findings.candidate_006_status: strengthened; preferred first patch changed from pinned-fd early release to correctness-first event-lock-held cold replay

run_findings.candidate_006_correctness_first_patch: acquire event-log lock before Mission View lock, double-check cold bootstrap, replay all retained generations oldest-to-newest, persist bootstrapped view, then release

run_findings.candidate_006_local_benchmark_scope: local synthetic ~128 MiB; not Argus production filesystem
run_findings.candidate_007_scope: Mission View materialized-view catch-up after canonical event acceptance and failed/missed projection; no production incident claim

run_findings.candidate_007_timestamp_cursor_insuffici: Mission View reducers are not globally idempotent; round.review.completed increments review.rejected_attempts, so overlapping timestamp replay can double-apply

run_findings.candidate_007_regression_2: force projection failure for round.review.completed status=continue; recovery must produce rejected_attempts exactly 1, not 0 or 2

run_findings.candidate_007_simple_baseline: one full stable all-generation rebuild after process restart even when materialized view is bootstrapped; correct but O(total retained history)
